audience.text: C++ developers building desktop or server applications that need to generate, read, or modify Excel .xlsx files without external runtime dependencies.

capabilities.text: Construct blank workbooks or load existing ones from file paths or in-memory streams, then save back to .xlsx format.
capabilities.title: Create and save .xlsx workbooks

capabilities.text: Store strings, numbers, booleans, and dates via Cell.PutValue(), retrieve values as CellValue, and set/get Excel formulas.
capabilities.title: Read and write cell values and formulas

capabilities.text: Modify fonts, colors, fills, borders, alignment, and number formats using Style and Font objects.
capabilities.title: Apply cell and range formatting

capabilities.text: Control visibility, zoom, gridlines, headers, right-to-left layout, protection, auto-filtering, and page setup.
capabilities.title: Manage worksheet features

capabilities.text: Define rule-based formatting and input constraints on cell ranges using FormatCondition and Validation objects.
capabilities.title: Apply conditional formatting and validation

capabilities.text: Attach hyperlinks to cells and define workbook- or worksheet-scoped named ranges with optional comments.
capabilities.title: Manage hyperlinks and defined names

capabilities.text: Read and write core and extended metadata through WorkbookProperties and DocumentProperties interfaces.
capabilities.title: Access document properties

capabilities.text: Build and link the library using CMake 3.16+ with no external dependencies.
capabilities.title: Integrate via CMake

limitations.text: Only .xlsx (OOXML) format is supported for loading and saving; other formats like .xls, .xlsb, .ods, or .csv are not supported.
Cell-level comments/notes are not modeled as a distinct object; only DefinedName includes a comment field.
Some advanced conditional-formatting rule types are dropped with a warning during load rather than preserved.
AutoFilter date-group filters using certain patterns are rejected as unsupported during load.
Legacy SpreadsheetML (Excel 2003 XML) is not implemented; mapper classes exist but unconditionally throw UnsupportedFeatureException.
Prebuilt binaries are only provided for Windows via NuGet; Linux and macOS require building from source.

problems_solved.text: Enables programmatic Excel workbook manipulation in C++ without requiring Microsoft Excel or commercial licensing.
Provides a consistent API surface compatible with Aspose.Cells commercial products for common spreadsheet tasks.
Supports cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS through a pure C++17 implementation with CMake integration.

product_summary.text: Aspose.Cells FOSS for C++ is a dependency-free, open-source C++17 library for creating, loading, editing, and saving Excel .xlsx workbooks without requiring Microsoft Excel.

uncertainties: The exact set of supported conditional formatting rule types that are preserved versus dropped is not fully enumerated in the facts.
The behavior of Workbook constructors when loading corrupted or partially valid .xlsx streams is not specified beyond InvalidFileFormatException.
Whether the library supports saving to streams other than file paths or std::vector<uint8_t> is not confirmed by the facts.

workflows.name: Load and read existing workbooks

workflows.name: Apply formatting and conditional rules

workflows.name: Configure print and view settings
workflows.text: Set page setup properties, visibility, zoom, gridlines, and worksheet protection directly on Worksheet objects.
